rootText: Home Lifestage New To Workforce New To Workforce Getting your first pay cheque is exciting, but it's also the perfect moment to begin planning your future with intention. By laying a strong foundation of protection and financial planning now, you can build a secure future with greater ease. Contact us Lay the groundwork for your best years Plan for a brighter tomorrow by prioritising the things that matter most to you. Medium priority Protection In the event of unexpected circumstances such as critical illnesses, accidents or disability, your needs and livelihood might be affected. Your priority for protection: Health insurance for hospitalisation.Protection against accidents and major illnesses so that your needs during recovery continue to be met.Financial payout for death, terminal illness, and total and permanent disability. Plan your protection Medium priority Wealth Saving for and investing in your upcoming milestones are easier the earlier you start. Your priority for wealth: Savings for future expenses such as home purchase and marriage.A retirement plan. Build your wealth Learn more about your needs Protection Wealth Protection The younger you get insured, the better. Now that you've started earning, saving for the things that matter will be much easier without worrying about medical bills. What you already have¹ If you are a Singaporean or PR, you’re automatically covered by three national schemes: MediSave A national savings scheme which helps CPF members save for future medical expenses, especially during retirement. MediShield Life A health insurance for large hospital bills and selected outpatient treatment costs. CareShield Life Long-term care insurance scheme for financial support and monthly cash payouts in event of severe disability. What you may consider² Beyond the basic coverage from national schemes, you’ll still need to ensure that you are sufficiently covered to avoid dipping into any hard-earned savings. National schemes do not fully cover: Hospitalisation An Integrated Shield Plan (IP) provides additional coverage for private hospitals or higher ward classes in public hospitals. Critical Illness You’ll need coverage of 4x annual income. (Recommended)³ Death & Total and Permanent Disability You’ll need coverage of 9 – 10x annual income. (Recommended)³ Make sure your insurance premiums fit comfortably within your budget. It’s recommended to spend at most 15% of take-home pay on insurance protection. Why act now Premiums increase as you get older². Less likely of pre-existing conditions that could exclude you from coverage². Connect with a Financial Representative for personalised coverage. Misconceptions? Let’s correct them. Check out some common misunderstandings about financial planning and their truths. Having health insurance means all treatments are fully covered. Learn more Health insurance is only for old people. Learn more I am young and healthy, I don’t need insurance.
